postal_system.assignment_rule: The Universal Postal Union September 2025 Universal DataBase lists Grenada among countries and territories which do not require postal codes. The UPU Grenada addressing sheet shows village, P.O. Box and municipality examples without a postcode. Current Grenada Postal Corporation and Government of Grenada pages publish the operator, head-office address, ten listed locations, 52 postal stations and six sub-offices without a postcode assignment or code table. A form ZIP field, airport code, parish code, locality identifier, AGID planning value or synthetic code seed is not a Grenada postal-code assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No national postal-code assignments exist to anchor postal-code Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Grenada, Carriacou, Petite Martinique, island, parish, district, administrative, locality, neighbourhood, address, post-office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi, raster, AGID planning-cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as official, derived or virtual postal-code area geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, house or building number, street, locality, parish or region and Grenada as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postal code into domestic addresses. The UPU sheet records WEST INDIES as optional wording, not a postcode. International commerce or travel forms that request ZIP/postal code are application constraints, not Grenada Postal Corporation authority.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store post offices, postal boxes, parcel services, routes, organizations and other service objects independently. A non-area object never becomes a postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon without an authoritative code assignment and reviewed geometry relationship.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic address identity and explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A locality, office, route, parish, island, parcel, coordinate, proximity or synthetic GD code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-postcode or independently typed context for GD, never manufacture a code or postal surface, and preserve source, version, request digest, time, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. GD planning cells and crosswalks may index separately authorized administrative, locality, route or building evidence, but they are never Grenada Postal Corporation codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed Grenada Postal Corporation pages state all rights reserved and publish no open postal dataset licence. The Government of Grenada page is copyright-marked and publishes no postcode dataset licence. UPU material is copyright- and database-controlled reference evidence. No processing, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving right for a postal dataset is inferred from web access.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO GD identity for Grenada, including source-described Carriacou and Petite Martinique objects without merging or reassigning their identity. Do not borrow codes or geometry from another Caribbean state or territory.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, recipients, postal-box holders, parcel observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs can expose personal or property context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless authority, purpose, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode status is time-dependent. Store retrieval time, publication or edition, exact bytes and SHA-256, and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when Grenada Postal Corporation or UPU announces a Grenada postal-code system. Never rewrite historical evidence as timeless.

stages.definition: Grenada address-format inventory, draft country pack, synthetic planning cells and conformance fixtures only.

Digest-bound Grenada Postal Corporation, Government of Grenada and UPU evidence that Grenada currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, identity, privacy, address-format correction and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Grenada Postal Corporation or competent public release establishing a Grenada postal-code system and a complete finite denominator of every code assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU September 2025 list records Grenada among countries and territories which do not require postal codes; the UPU Grenada sheet and current GPC/government references publish postal addresses, locations, stations, sub-offices and services but no code assignment or code table. Absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique retain their source identity. Islands, parishes, districts, administrative areas, localities, neighbourhoods, addresses, offices, routes, service areas, parcels, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells, airport codes, commerce ZIP placeholders, synthetic GD planning codes and code seeds are prohibited proxies. Postal-office, postal-box, parcel, route, organization, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real GD API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: GD metadata, no-postcode policy, address-format correction and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real GD Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual GD loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Grenada postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, locality, route, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
